{{Quote|Hello there, I'm looking for someone to help us out by destroying the droids that are swarming the facility. Are you up for a little fighting?|Sergeant Mener, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:D10BD" />}}
'''Mener''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Looks like you cut through the battle droids without any trouble. Well done. With their numbers reduced we can start gunning for the bigger game.|Sergeant Mener, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:D10BD" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mener held the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]]<ref name="SWG:D10BD" /> and was based in the city of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TtLV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Lieutenant Varias in the Corsec camp|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:Corellia_Droid_Factory_3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Battle droids patrolling the [[Corellia Droid Factory]]]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> CorSec received reports of hostile [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&ndash;era [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] active in the [[Bindreg Hills]]. A group led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Varias]], including Sergeant Mener, [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] [[Hirka]], [[Druno Kener|Kener]] and [[Jornel Savas|Savas]], and several CorSec troopers, was dispatched from Coronet to investigate. The unit discovered an old and fully automated [[Corellia Droid Factory|droid factory]], presumably built in secret by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" /> CorSec ignored that the factory had been reactivated by [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] for his project of [[Droid Revolution]].<ref name="SWG:DtDF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disable the Droid Factory|Corellia}}</ref>

The droid factory was defended by many hostile battle droids, but the Corellian government was reluctant to send reinforcement since it preferred to avoid drawing the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Independent spacers were thus recruited to assist CorSec in the factory.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" /> As Sergeant Mener was tasked to lead the fight against the droids, he enrolled several spacers to destroy as many droids as possible. The spacers destroyed more than two dozens of droids, including [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="SWG:D10BD" /><ref name="SWG:D10SBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Destroy 10 Super Battle Droids|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="SWG:D5D">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Destroy 5 Droidekas" on Corellia</ref> The spacers also fought an epic battle against a very powerful prototype of an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series]]-like battle droid.<ref name="SWG:DtPD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Destroy the Prototype Droid|Corellia}}</ref> Eventually, CorSec and the spacers shut down the Corellia Droid Factory.<ref name="SWG:DtDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Mener was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:D10BD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sergeant Mener was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Corellia Droid Factory|Corellian Droid Factory]]" arc with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
